description: This file defines the main route/component for a personal notes manager web application built with Qwik. It manages state, handles user interactions such as creating, deleting, and updating notes, and renders the main UI including a top bar, note list, editor, and footer. It also includes logic for loading and saving notes to local storage.

methods.name: filterNotesByTitle
methods.description: Filters an array of notes based on a search query matching the note titles.

methods.name: component$
methods.description: Main Qwik component that renders the notes app UI, manages state, and handles user interactions.
